prereq: 单设备的安装、恢复、备份、安全和升级路径已稳定。
事件、lease、fencing token、记忆版本和设备身份已有稳定契约。
多设备必须共享一个逻辑身份、事件、记忆和授权，同时不绕过审批、幂等和撤销。
contracts: 同步事实
事件按 cursor 增量同步；投影可从事件重建；冲突有明确处理。
单写者
lease 与 fencing token 保证同一任务只有一个执行权；离线队列不能重复副作用。
设备撤销
撤销设备立即失效其会话、审批和读取权限，同时保留可审计记录。
迁移完整性
备份、恢复、迁移和升级必须验证事件、产物、记忆、技能与凭据引用。
长期运行
健康检查、配额、资源回收、维护模式与 kill switch 可观测、可恢复。
failures: 任务显示设备与同步状态，不把离线误判为失败。
保留本地队列、重连后按 cursor 合并，避免重复执行。
设备状态标记“撤销未完成”，阻断审批和读取。
使会话失效、轮换密钥、清除本地缓存，并重新验证。
恢复进入“需要验证”，阻止对外宣称完成。
对比事件、产物、记忆与技能清单，修复后重跑迁移演练。
exclusions: 不把多个不一致的 Agent 包装成多设备支持。
不用同步冲突或离线队列解释重复外部动作。
不在没有迁移演练和设备撤销的情况下宣布 v1.0。

prereq: Single-device install, recovery, backup, security, and upgrade paths are stable.
Events, leases, fencing tokens, memory versions, and device identity have stable contracts.
Multiple devices share one logical identity, event history, memory, and authority without bypassing approval, idempotency, or revocation.
contracts: Synchronized facts
Events sync incrementally by cursor; projections rebuild from events; conflicts have explicit handling.
Single writer
Lease and fencing tokens guarantee one execution authority per task; offline queues cannot duplicate side effects.
Device revocation
Revocation immediately invalidates sessions, approvals, and read access while retaining audit evidence.
Migration integrity
Backup, restore, migration, and upgrade verify events, artifacts, memory, skills, and credential references.
Long-running operations
Health checks, quotas, reclamation, maintenance mode, and kill switches are observable and recoverable.
failures: The task shows device and sync state and does not mistake offline for failure.
Keep the local queue, merge by cursor after reconnect, and prevent duplicate execution.
An old device still has access
Device state says Revocation incomplete and blocks approval and reads.
Invalidate sessions, rotate keys, clear local caches, and verify again.
Recovery enters Needs verification and blocks a completion claim.
Compare events, artifacts, memory, and skill manifests, repair, and rerun the drill.
exclusions: Do not package multiple inconsistent agents as multi-device support.
Do not excuse duplicate external actions through sync conflicts or offline queues.
Do not declare v1.0 without migration drills and device revocation.

zh.title: 多设备读取与事件同步
zh.lead: 先证明一个逻辑 Agent 的任务和产物能在多台设备上一致呈现，再讨论设备执行能力。
zh.outcome: 用户在第二台设备上看到一致的任务、产物和状态，并能判断任务在哪台设备上执行。
steps: 实现事件同步、cursor 和增量拉取，保留断线重连状态。
建立投影同步、设备身份和只读副本。
实现冲突检测、重放和同步范围过滤。
增加设备状态页，显示在线、最后同步和执行位置。
过滤敏感字段，避免无条件复制完整任务上下文。
验证离线设备不阻塞主设备，投影可以从事件重建。
zh.gate: 设备切换不丢任务；投影可重建；同步冲突有明确处理；敏感数据不无条件复制；离线设备不阻塞主设备。
evidence: 设备状态页与只读副本

en.title: Multi-device reads and event sync
en.lead: First prove one logical agent's tasks and artifacts appear consistently across devices before discussing device execution.
en.outcome: Users see consistent tasks, artifacts, and state on a second device and can tell where a task runs.
steps: Implement event sync, cursors, and incremental pull with reconnect state.
Create projection sync, device identity, and a read-only replica.
Implement conflict detection, replay, and sync-scope filtering.
Add a device status page with online state, last sync, and execution location.
Filter sensitive fields instead of copying full task context unconditionally.
Verify an offline device does not block the primary device and projections rebuild from events.
en.gate: Switching devices loses no task; projections rebuild; sync conflicts have explicit handling; sensitive data does not copy blindly; offline devices do not block the primary.

zh.title: 设备能力路由与离线队列
zh.lead: 任务应该去具备能力的设备执行；设备离线时排队等待，恢复后继续，而不是重复执行。
zh.outcome: 任务能选择具备所需能力的设备执行；设备离线时任务排队，恢复后继续，而不是重复执行。
steps: 建立设备能力目录与任务需求匹配规则。
实现路由、lease、fencing token 与单写者。
加入离线队列、执行权交接、设备重连和任务迁移。
对重复副作用、旧 lease 和双写进行故障注入。
在所有外部动作上继续要求 Receipt 与对账。
验证多设备不重复执行，离线恢复有明确状态。
zh.gate: 多设备不重复执行；离线恢复有明确状态；设备切换后可继续；lease 失效不会造成双写；所有外部动作仍有 Receipt。

en.title: Device capability routing and offline queues
en.lead: Tasks should run on a device with the required capability; if it is offline, queue and continue later rather than execute twice.
en.outcome: Tasks choose a capable device; when it is offline they queue and resume without duplicate execution.
steps: Create a device-capability catalog and task-requirement matching rules.
Implement routing, lease, fencing token, and single-writer behavior.
Add offline queues, execution handoff, reconnection, and task migration.
Inject faults around duplicate effects, stale leases, and dual writes.
Require Receipt and reconciliation for every external action.
Verify devices do not duplicate execution and offline recovery has explicit state.
en.gate: No duplicate execution; offline recovery is explicit; work resumes after device switch; stale lease cannot dual-write; every external action still has a Receipt.

zh.title: 设备撤销、密钥轮换与安全迁移
zh.lead: 丢失设备必须能被立即切断审批、接管和读取能力，密钥轮换不能破坏历史事件的可验证性。
zh.outcome: 丢失设备可以被立即撤销；用户能重新配对、轮换密钥，并确认旧设备无法继续访问任务、记忆和凭据。
steps: 实现远程撤销、会话失效和本地数据擦除。
实现密钥轮换与重新配对，保留历史事件验证能力。
对传输、推送中继和设备凭据使用加密边界。
加入设备审计、异常访问告警和紧急 kill switch。
演练设备丢失、撤销未完成和重新配对。
确认旧设备无法审批、接管或读取新事件，安全事件有可读审计。
zh.gate: 撤销立即可靠；旧设备无法审批、接管或读取新事件；密钥轮换不破坏历史事件；安全事件有可读审计。

en.title: Device revocation, key rotation, and secure migration
en.lead: A lost device must immediately lose approval, takeover, and read access, and key rotation must preserve historical event verifiability.
en.outcome: Lost devices revoke immediately; users re-pair and rotate keys, and confirm the old device cannot access tasks, memory, or credentials.
steps: Implement remote revocation, session invalidation, and local data erasure.
Implement key rotation and re-pairing while preserving historical event verification.
Encrypt transport, push relay, and device credentials at their boundaries.
Add device audit, abnormal-access alerts, and an emergency kill switch.
Rehearse device loss, incomplete revocation, and re-pairing.
Confirm the old device cannot approve, take over, or read new events, and security events have readable audit.
en.gate: Revocation is immediate and reliable; old devices cannot approve, take over, or read new events; key rotation preserves history; security events have readable audit.

zh.title: 备份、恢复、迁移与升级
zh.lead: 让用户真正拥有自己的数据：可以备份、恢复、迁移和升级，失败时能回滚且不丢失历史。
zh.outcome: 用户可以导出、备份、恢复和迁移 Hearth；升级失败可以回滚，历史事件、记忆和技能保持一致。
steps: 实现加密备份、完整恢复、数据导出/导入和迁移清单。
加入 schema migration、执行器版本锁定和升级前检查。
实现升级失败回滚与迁移验证。
校验事件、产物、记忆、技能和凭据引用在迁移后仍一致。
提供用户可见健康检查和已知限制。
从空数据库完成安装、恢复、升级和回滚演练。
zh.gate: 迁移后事件、产物、记忆、技能和凭据引用可验证；回滚可用；旧数据不丢失；升级不要求手工修改数据库。

en.title: Backup, restore, migration, and upgrade
en.lead: Give users real ownership of their data: backup, restore, migrate, and upgrade with rollback and no loss of history.
en.outcome: Users export, back up, restore, and migrate Hearth; failed upgrades roll back with consistent events, memory, and skills.
steps: Implement encrypted backup, full restore, export/import, and a migration manifest.
Add schema migration, executor version pinning, and pre-upgrade checks.
Implement upgrade rollback and migration verification.
Verify events, artifacts, memory, skills, and credential references stay consistent after migration.
Provide user-visible health checks and known limitations.
Rehearse install, restore, upgrade, and rollback from an empty database.
en.gate: Events, artifacts, memory, skills, and credential references verify after migration; rollback works; old data survives; upgrades need no manual database edits.

zh.title: 长期运行、资源调度与运维
zh.lead: 把“偶尔能跑”变成“长期驻留”：资源、任务、失败和健康状态都可见，维护不需要每天手工干预。
zh.outcome: Hearth 能长期驻留，用户能看到资源、任务、失败和健康状态，不需要每天维护。
steps: 实现资源调度、配额、并发上限和公平性。
加入 watchdog、自动恢复、日志轮转和磁盘管理。
建立长期指标、健康检查和维护模式。
对资源耗尽、内存泄漏和状态漂移进行压力测试。
评估远程 Sandbox 是否必要，默认不引入新的安全边界。
让用户能导出诊断信息并安全降级。
zh.gate: 长期运行无内存泄漏和状态漂移；资源耗尽可安全降级；维护模式不丢任务；用户能导出诊断信息。

en.title: Long-running operations, resources, and maintenance
en.lead: Turn occasionally runnable into long-resident: resources, tasks, failures, and health are visible, and maintenance does not require daily intervention.
en.outcome: Hearth runs long term; users see resources, tasks, failures, and health without daily maintenance.
steps: Implement resource scheduling, quotas, concurrency limits, and fairness.
Add watchdog, automatic recovery, log rotation, and disk management.
Create long-term metrics, health checks, and maintenance mode.
Stress-test resource exhaustion, memory leaks, and state drift.
Evaluate whether remote Sandbox is necessary; default to no new security boundary.
Let users export diagnostics and degrade safely.
en.gate: Long-running operation has no leak or state drift; exhaustion degrades safely; maintenance mode loses no task; users export diagnostics.

zh.title: v1.0 审计与发布
zh.lead: 用完整出口条件、八类任务覆盖、安全红队、故障注入和迁移演练收束到可安装、可撤销、可长期使用的 v1.0。
zh.outcome: 一个可安装、可迁移、可撤销、可长期使用的 Hearth v1.0。
steps: 通过 Stage 0–6 全部出口，收集可复查的证据而不是口头声明。
完成八类任务覆盖审计，明确哪些可依赖、哪些必须转人工。
执行安全红队、故障注入、迁移与撤销演练。
完成隐私说明、安装器、升级路径和支持文档。
发布最终评测报告，记录成功率、人工分钟、Token、失败与恢复。
确认产品可以在真实个人环境中持续使用，没有严重未解决的安全或恢复问题。
zh.gate: 25.15 的“100% 定义”全部满足；没有严重未解决的安全或恢复问题；核心任务族达到目标成熟度；产品可以在真实个人环境中持续使用。
evidence: 红队/故障注入/迁移报告
安装、隐私、升级与最终评测

en.title: v1.0 audit and release
en.lead: Close to an installable, portable, revocable, long-running v1.0 through complete exits, eight-family coverage, red teaming, fault injection, and migration drills.
en.outcome: An installable, portable, revocable, long-running Hearth v1.0.
steps: Pass every Stage 0–6 exit with reviewable evidence, not verbal declarations.
Complete the eight-family coverage audit, stating what is reliable and what must go to a human.
Run security red teaming, fault injection, migration, and revocation drills.
Complete privacy guidance, installer, upgrade path, and support documentation.
Publish the final evaluation with success, manual minutes, Token, failure, and recovery data.
Confirm the product runs in a real personal environment with no severe unresolved security or recovery issue.
en.gate: Every condition in the 100% definition holds; no severe unresolved security or recovery issue remains; core task families reach target maturity; the product is usable long term.
evidence: Install, privacy, upgrade, and final evaluation
